summary: Work orders and invoice total wrong on work order page
reported_issue: On the work orders list page the totals were wrong - off by a few pennies while in work-order status, and 'way out' once invoiced. They should always match the finance tab (same source, no separate calculation).
expected_after_fix: The total shown on the work orders list must equal the finance tab total for the same work order.
steps_i_followed: Fetched the work orders list via API and recorded each WO totalPrice (cents)
Opened the Finance tab for several WOs (invoiced and paid) and read the finance Total/Payments/Balance
Compared list totals against finance totals
actual_now: List total equals finance Total for every WO checked: S9-24674 $1,397.49=$1,397.49; S9-24662 $1,618.06=$1,618.06; S9-24656 (paid) $1,348.39=$1,348.39 (payments $1,348.39, balance $0.00); S9-24669 $1,078.71=$1,078.71. No penny discrepancies and no large mismatches on invoiced orders.
notes: List totalPrice (in cents) matches finance Total across work-order, invoiced, and paid statuses.
